recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13923 unless a future work group decision changes the NDJSON/asynchronous REST guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-13923 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core request to document use of ND-JSON and state that ND-JSON should be restricted to the asynchronous use case.
initial_application: No implementation commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-13923 was found. The NDJSON page was added in f57d0e635ba214885a60127ad55ad9b1f0b7f7f5 with the bulk-data description and async-only REST retrieval rule; d29aec59f8eb7f583a0c3aacfa55c22dffb686da later corrected the page to use application/fhir+ndjson.
additional_context: source/nd-json.html is active in the current build through source/hierarchy.xml and is linked from documentation, resource-formats, and downloads pages. Community searches found no direct Confluence reference to FHIR-13923 or conflicting Zulip/Confluence decision; broader NDJSON/asynchronous hits were consistent with async bulk-data use.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current NDJSON page says NDJSON is supported for bulk data transfer, identifies application/fhir+ndjson, requires a single resource type per NDJSON document, and says RESTful API NDJSON can only be retrieved using the Asynchronous Pattern.
